headline: Egg price hits Tk 15 per piece in Dhaka markets, dozen up to Tk 160
summary: Egg prices have surged in Dhaka, with a single egg costing Tk 15 in local shops, making protein increasingly unaffordable for low-income families. This rise is attributed to increased feed costs, transport, and seasonal low production.
details: Egg prices have seen a significant hike in Dhaka markets, with a single farm egg now costing Tk 15 in local shops. A pack of four (hali) sells for Tk 55, while a dozen brown eggs are priced between Tk 155-160, marking a Tk 10 increase in just one week.

This surge makes eggs, a primary protein source for low and middle-income families, increasingly unaffordable. Broiler chicken prices have also remained high, around Tk 200 per kg, for the past two months, adding to the financial strain.

Retailers blame rising costs of poultry feed, medicine, and increased transportation expenses. Frequent load shedding, requiring generators run on diesel, also contributes to higher operational costs for producers. Some also cite seasonal factors, with chickens laying fewer eggs during humid and hot weather.

Kaysar Ahmed, MD of Diamond Egg, a leading producer, stated that poultry feed prices have jumped by up to Tk 12 per kg in two months. He noted that it takes one kg of feed to produce eight eggs, meaning the cost for two hali (eight eggs) has increased by Tk 12. He also mentioned that a portion of feed raw materials now comes from the US due to trade agreements, potentially driving up prices.

While the Department of Livestock reports an annual production of approximately 2,441 crore eggs for FY 2024-25, with per capita availability over 137 eggs, the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS) 2022 survey showed a decline in daily per capita egg consumption to 12.7 grams from 13.6 grams in 2016. This decline is linked to rising prices.

Historically, egg prices fluctuated between Tk 85-120 per dozen before the Russia-Ukraine war in 2022. Post-war, prices have consistently ranged from Tk 125-160 per dozen, occasionally spiking higher, such as to Tk 200 per dozen in mid-October 2024.

According to the Trading Corporation of Bangladesh (TCB), a hali of eggs was Tk 50-55 yesterday, an 11% increase from last year. The Ministry of Commerce held a meeting on September 27 with the poultry sector to review production costs and profit margins. Commerce Minister Khandaker Abdul Muktadir acknowledged the direct pressure on low and middle-income people when egg prices rise abnormally.

Compared to neighboring countries, Bangladesh's egg prices are significantly higher. A dozen eggs cost Tk 115 in Pakistan, Tk 138 in Sri Lanka, and Tk 115 in Kolkata, India, according to their respective statistical bureaus and reports.

A 2024 study by the Bangladesh Trade and Tariff Commission (BTTC) indicates that the prices of day-old chicks, poultry feed, and eggs are higher in Bangladesh than in India and Pakistan. The study attributes this to 'excessive' protection provided by strictly controlled imports.

Low-income residents are struggling to cope. Shahana Akter from Mohammadpur's Tajmahal Road expressed frustration, stating, 'First liquid milk, then soybean oil, flour, and sugar, and now eggs. What will people eat if prices keep rising like this?'

headline_marked: [[Bangladesh in trouble losing three wickets]] as Parvez Hossain departs in Asian Games semi-final against Pakistan
headline: Bangladesh in trouble losing three wickets as Parvez Hossain departs in Asian Games semi-final against Pakistan
summary: Bangladesh's top order struggled against Pakistan's bowling attack in the Asian Games semi-final, with key batsmen falling quickly after Pakistan opted to field first in the 13-over match.
details: Bangladesh is in a precarious position, having lost three crucial wickets against Pakistan in the Asian Games cricket semi-final. Pakistan won the toss and elected to field first in the rain-affected 13-over match.
Opener Tanzid Hasan was the first to depart, caught at mid-off after hitting a six. Saif Hassan followed, scoring 19 runs off 17 balls with two sixes before being dismissed leg-before-wicket.

Liton Das's innings was brief, lasting just three balls before he was bowled attempting a reverse sweep. Parvez Hossain then became the third wicket to fall, caught at deep square while trying a slog sweep.
The pitch shows clear cracks, making batting challenging. Despite the early struggles, Towhid Hridoy remains unbeaten on 11 runs off 10 balls, contributing to a 15-run over with Saif earlier.
Initially, the match faced delays due to a wet outfield, but sunny weather allowed play to commence. The game was reduced to 13 overs per side to ensure completion.
Bangladesh's squad for this crucial semi-final includes four spinners alongside two pacers, indicating a strategy to leverage spin on the challenging pitch.
This semi-final follows both teams' quarter-final matches being washed out by rain, with Pakistan advancing due to a higher ranking. The winner will proceed to the final.
caption:
Bangladesh lost three quick wickets in their Asian Games semi-final against Pakistan. The match, reduced to 13 overs, saw Pakistan opt to field first.

Bangladesh is in a precarious position, having lost three crucial wickets against Pakistan in the Asian Games cricket semi-final. Pakistan won the toss and elected to field first in the rain-affected 13-over match.

Opener Tanzid Hasan was the first to depart, caught at mid-off after hitting a six. Saif Hassan followed, scoring 19 runs off 17 balls with two sixes before being dismissed leg-before-wicket.

Liton Das's innings was brief, lasting just three balls before he was bowled attempting a reverse sweep. Parvez Hossain then became the third wicket to fall, caught at deep square while trying a slog sweep.

The pitch shows clear cracks, making batting challenging. Despite the early struggles, Towhid Hridoy remains unbeaten on 11 runs off 10 balls, contributing to a 15-run over with Saif earlier.

Initially, the match faced delays due to a wet outfield, but sunny weather allowed play to commence. The game was reduced to 13 overs per side to ensure completion.

Bangladesh's squad for this crucial semi-final includes four spinners alongside two pacers, indicating a strategy to leverage spin on the challenging pitch.

This semi-final follows both teams' quarter-final matches being washed out by rain, with Pakistan advancing due to a higher ranking. The winner will proceed to the final.
